title: Dimension of a binary field extension
statement: Let $\ell$ be a natural number, and let $m(X)$ be a monic polynomial of degree $\ell$ over the field with two elements, with its lower coefficients specified by a binary vector. If $m(X)$ is irreducible, then the quotient field obtained by adjoining a root of $m$ has dimension $\ell$ over the field with two elements.
hypotheses_covered: The implementation specifies a binary coefficient vector for the monic modulus
